name: CRITICAL WARNING: Crushed Red Pepper Pizza Flakes (Chili Flakes & Hard Seeds)
whyItWorks: DUAL THREAT: The hard yellow internal seeds are completely indigestible and can mechanically wedge into narrowed strictures, while the dry chili skin flakes deliver concentrated capsaicin burns along the entire GI tract.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Never shake crushed red pepper flakes onto pizza or pasta. Stick to dried oregano and grated aged parmesan.
